overview.authority: IKGPTU (Inder Kumar Gujral Punjab Technical University), Jalandhar
overview.applies_to: Centralized Online Counselling for admission to Affiliated/Autonomous Colleges of IKGPTU and MRSPTU Bathinda

courses_covered.name: B.Tech & B.Tech Fee Waiver (2nd Year, Lateral Entry)

registration_steps: Go to the counselling registration URL and click APPLY FOR NEW REGISTRATION
Read the important instructions and click I Agree to open the Registration Form
Fill required details based on selected State of Eligibility and Course
Fill Profile details as per 10th certificate, then click Get OTP; OTP sent to registered mobile and email; enter OTP and click Verify OTP
After registration, log in using Reference No. and Password sent via email
Fill Contact Details and click Save & Next
Fill Reservation and Other Details and click Save & Next
Fill Qualification Details as per certificates and click Save & Next
Review the complete Application Form; if correct, tick checkbox and click Save & Final Submit to lock details
Upload required documents one by one from the dropdown list
Tick checkbox and click Pay Counselling Fee; complete payment
After payment confirmation, proceed to Fill & Save Choices in preference order (at least 1 choice required), then Lock Choices
Candidates opting for Tuition Fee Waiver (TFW) should place TFW-suffixed course choices at the top of their preference order
Merit list and rank prepared based on application details; Provisional Seat Allotment Letter issued based on rank and preferences
Print the provisional allotment letter and report to the allotted institute with required documents and applicable semester fee to confirm the seat
Confirmed seat can be withdrawn using the Withdraw/Surrender Seat option

application_form_instructions.prefilled_fields: Name, Father Name, Mother Name, DOB & Gender are prefilled from the Registration Form
application_form_instructions.state_of_eligibility: Candidate selects either Punjab State (85% Quota) or Other State (15% Quota); further options depend on this selection
application_form_instructions.category: 13 category types for Punjab State (85% Quota) candidates, 3 category types for Other State (15% Quota) candidates. Relevant certificate required if a reserved category is selected.

tuition_fee_waiver_scheme.eligibility: Punjab State residents whose parents' annual family income (all sources) is less than Rs. 8 lakhs for the current financial year
documents_required_at_admission: Income Certificate (current year, issued by Govt. of Punjab / Suvidha Kendra)
tuition_fee_waiver_scheme.seat_availability: Very limited - 5% of intake, subject to availability and merit
rules: SC/ST students eligible for Post Matric Scholarship Scheme are advised NOT to opt for TFW, since availing a TFW seat disqualifies them from Post Matric Scholarship
Students admitted under TFW cannot change institution or course under any circumstances
TFW applies for the complete duration of the course
TFW students are not entitled to any other government financial assistance scheme, but remain eligible for merit/competition-based scholarships
TFW covers only the tuition fee prescribed by the State Government; all other fees must be paid by the student
Students confirmed under TFW in round 1 can participate in round 2 counselling only for normal (non-TFW) seats

notes: Rs. 2,000 required per course; applying for two separate courses (e.g. B.Arch and B.Tech) requires paying Rs. 2,000 for each, totaling Rs. 4,000
If fee is paid in round 1, it is not required again to participate in round 2
Applicable to both 85% quota and 15% quota candidates, regardless of category
Only candidates who have paid the counselling fee can fill choices
Fee once paid is neither refunded nor transferable to another course

documents: Residential Certificate (Domicile or valid Address Proof)
Migration Certificate of qualifying exam (if applicable)
DMC of 10+2 if Diploma in Lateral Entry
DMCs of Diploma (if Graduation done under Lateral Entry)

choice_filling.description: After rank is assigned, candidates see available choices based on category and filled credentials. Choices can be selected, reordered (up/down or swap), deleted, and must be locked at the end.
choice_filling.auto_lock: Unlocked saved choices are automatically locked at the closing time of the Choice Filling window.

result_and_reporting.result_declaration: Candidates check results via their login account; provisional allotment letter is issued and candidates are also notified by SMS. Allotment is purely provisional until confirmed by the allotted institute.
result_and_reporting.reporting_requirements: Candidate must submit the Provisional Allotment Letter with original documents and pay the applicable semester fee at the allotted institute within the prescribed period to confirm the seat. Mismatched or tampered documents lead to rejection of the allotted seat.
result_and_reporting.seat_withdrawal: Confirmed seat can be withdrawn during the reporting period of each round, or within 7 days from the last date of reporting of the last counselling round.

second_round_participation.eligibility: Candidates from both 85% Punjab quota and 15% Other State quota can participate in round 2, regardless of whether they got a seat in round 1, using the same counselling fee already paid (no need to pay again)
rules: If a new seat is allotted in round 2, the previous provisional admission is automatically cancelled with no right to claim it
If no new seat is allotted in round 2, the seat confirmed in round 1 is retained
Candidates confirmed under TFW in round 1 can participate in round 2 only for normal (non-TFW) seats; TFW seats are not shown to them in round 2

undergraduate_programmes.tfw_note: Available only under B.Tech and B.Pharmacy for Punjab residents with annual family income below Rs. 8 lakhs

pg_and_other_programmes.tfw_note: Available only under BCA for Punjab residents with annual family income below Rs. 8 lakhs

lateral_entry_programmes.special_note: 1st round of B.Pharmacy Lateral Entry counselling is for Punjab candidates only; vacant seats in round 2 go to Other State candidates. For other lateral entry programmes, Punjab (85%) and Other State (15%) quota counselling happens simultaneously.

general_notes: Post-Matric Scholarship (PMS) Scheme is available as per Punjab Government norms
Candidates must carry all relevant original documents at time of reporting, or the provisionally allotted seat will be cancelled with no right to claim it again
After 2 rounds of centralized counselling, remaining admissions are made at Campus/College level
